diego_tinker: Venezuelan man in his mid 20s, lean and wiry with quick hands, thick black hair falling over his forehead, dark eyes and a sharp jaw, a bright open good-looking face. Brass-and-canvas tinker's gear, a heavy wrench-hammer at his hip, goggles pushed up on his head. A phone-repair spudger, bright blue plastic scuffed white at the tip, in his breast pocket.
freja_priest: Danish woman in her late 20s, tall and slim with a dancer's posture, long pale blonde hair braided back, grey-blue eyes, fine straight features. White and soft-gold priest robes with a pale blue mantle, a slim silver censer at the belt. A midwife's wooden pinard horn, polished dark with handling, at her side.
sondre_stormbringer: Norwegian man in his late 20s, tall and rangy with broad flat shoulders, dark blond hair pushed back and wind-wrecked, pale grey eyes, a weather-reddened face. Storm-blue layered robes with a short cloak that lifts on its own, a long bone-white stave, faint static along his forearms. A sailing-dinghy shackle key on a lanyard at his throat.
berat_tinker: Turkish man in his late 20s, compact and sturdy, dark curls cut close at the sides, heavy black brows, warm brown eyes, an open face that smiles easily. Copper-plated tinker's coat in oxblood and brass, a backpack of tubes and gauges leaking soft green healing light. A dentist's angled chrome mouth mirror tucked behind one ear.
matias_reaper: Chilean man in his late 20s, slim and hard through the shoulders, black hair worn a little long and shoved back, dark eyes, high cheekbones. Charcoal and bone-grey reaper leathers with a hooded half-cape, a long curved scythe-blade carried low, faint violet light at the edge. A bus conductor's brass ticket punch on a cord at his belt.
giorgi_primalist: Georgian man in his mid 30s, big through the chest with heavy forearms, thick dark hair and a short full beard, deep-set hazel eyes. Green and tan hide over mail, a hand-carved totem stave across his back, a hawk's feather bound into it. A shepherd's small dented brass bell, knotted to his belt so it cannot ring.
camille_ranger: French woman in her early 30s, slim and long-legged, dark brown hair in a thick loose plait over one shoulder, green eyes, elegant features and a faint knowing half-smile. Deep green and oxblood brigand leathers cut close, a hooded short cloak, a long dagger at the hip. A slim silver bicycle-spoke wrench threaded onto her belt.
orlando_witchdoctor: Puerto Rican man in his early 30s, broad-shouldered and trim, black hair in a short fade, warm brown skin, an easy infectious grin. Bone and indigo witch doctor's gear, feathers and carved charms at the shoulder, a mask pushed up onto his forehead, a gourd rattle at his belt. A barber's pearl-handled straight razor in a sleeve pocket.
adrian_templar: Spanish man in his early 30s, tall and square-shouldered, black hair cut short, close dark beard, a strong jaw. Polished steel and ivory templar plate with a deep red tabard, a one-handed sword and a shield at his back, faint gold light at the seams. A referee's whistle on a black lanyard inside the collar.
saoirse_starcaller: Irish woman in her early 30s, tall and strongly built, long copper-red hair tied back in a heavy knot, pale freckled skin, grey-green eyes. Silver and midnight-blue plate, a round shield with a crescent boss, a short spear, cold moonlight along the armour edges. A hurling sliotar, scuffed and grass-stained, in a net at her belt.
nicolas_bloodmage: Peruvian man in his early 30s, compact and visibly strong, black hair swept back, dark eyes, high cheekbones. Crimson and black plate worn heavy, a broad shield, a short thick blade, dull red light moving under the plate like something circulating. A paramedic's folding tourniquet windlass clipped at his shoulder.
ileana_necromancer: Romanian woman in her mid 30s, slender and very upright, dark brown hair cut in a sharp chin-length bob, pale skin, dark eyes, fine sculpted features. Frost-white and deep grey robes with a high collar, a staff of pale bound bone, breath fogging and rime creeping along her sleeves. A violinist's black curved shoulder rest strapped flat across her back.
thiago_paladin: Brazilian man in his early 30s, tall and powerfully built, black curls cropped close, warm brown skin, a broad open face with a ready smile. Gold and white paladin plate worn light at the shoulder, a warhammer carried head-down, a soft gold glow around his gauntlets. A physiotherapist's half-used roll of bright blue kinesiology tape in a belt pouch.
skye_pyromancer: Australian woman in her early 30s, athletic and sun-browned, long honey-blonde hair pulled up messily, light blue eyes, freckles. Scorched orange and ash robes cut short at the sleeve, a slim rod wrapped in blackened wire, heat shimmer off her forearms. A firefighter's yellow smoke-stained helmet torch clipped at her belt.
vuk_knight: Serbian man in his mid 30s, very tall and heavy-framed, dark hair shaved close at the sides, pale eyes, an old thin scar through one brow. Black and dull-iron war plate with a torn dark surcoat, a two-handed axe across his back, faint cold green light in the gorget. A cast-iron domino tile, double six, carried in one glove.
khalid_hunter: Emirati man in his mid 30s, tall and lean, black hair under a loosely wrapped cloth headscarf, close beard, dark eyes, a hawkish face. Sand, grey and deep red survival leathers with a short cloak, a long recurve bow and a heavy belt knife, traps and cord at his hip. A falconer's small tooled leather hood hanging from his belt.
karim_felsworn: Jordanian man in his mid 30s, tall and lean-muscled, black hair cut short, close-trimmed beard, dark eyes with a faint green cast. Dark iron and fel-green plate with heavy pauldrons, a jagged greatsword across the back, green light bleeding from the joints. A surveyor's brass plumb bob on a worn cord at his hip.
osvaldo_warlock: Cuban man in his late 30s, broad-chested and thick-armed, black hair shaved close, warm brown skin, a heavy-browed face that rarely moves. Scorched black and ember-orange robes with the sleeves burned back, a staff capped in a slowly burning coal, soot on his hands. A trumpet mouthpiece, brass gone dull gold, on a cord round his neck.
bashir_witchhunter: Palestinian man in his early 40s, tall and spare with long hard forearms, black hair cut short and grey at the temples, a severe face with a strong nose. Black and bleached-bone leathers under a long storm coat, a heavy crossbow at the hip, a silvered blade, a lantern burning pale white. A stonemason's blue-dusted chalk line reel at his belt.
gianluca_guardian: Italian man in his late 30s, broad and solidly built, dark hair greying at the temples, close beard, brown eyes, a lined face that looks faintly amused. Burnished bronze and deep blue plate, a kite shield, a short stabbing sword, a furled banner behind one shoulder. A barista's brass coffee tamper, handle worn smooth, at his belt.
elias_suncleric: Dominican man in his early 30s, tall and lean with long limbs, black hair in a short twist-out, dark brown skin, warm dark eyes, a wide calm mouth. White and radiant gold plate with layered feathered pauldrons, a tall tower shield, light collecting above his shoulders. A mechanic's round telescoping inspection mirror in his gauntlet cuff.
rui_cultist: Portuguese man in his mid 30s, slim and a little gaunt, dark hair worn loose to the jaw, deep-set dark eyes, hollow cheeks. Deep violet and black robes with a torn high collar, a thin crooked staff, shadow pooling and moving wrongly around his feet. A fisherman's salt-bleached wooden net needle through his belt.
nizar_chronomancer: Syrian man in his early 40s, tall and very upright, black hair greying at the sides, neat beard, dark eyes, deep laugh lines. Pale sand and deep teal robes with layered geometric trim, a staff of slowly counter-rotating brass rings, faint afterimages trailing his hands. A pocket watch with a cracked crystal, running backwards, on a fine chain.
yusuf_venomancer: Iraqi man in his early 40s, broad and heavy-set but light on his feet, black hair receding and swept back, thick moustache and short beard. Dark green and gold robes with wide sleeves, a serpent-carved stave, corked vials in a bandolier across his chest. A pharmacist's scratched brass pill-counting tray slung flat at his back.
